name: Sambalpur

routes.outcome: Official Odisha Revenue & Disaster Management Department BhuNaksha landing page. Its current JavaScript maps district code 12 (Sambalpur), 15 and 30 to https://app2bhunakshaodisha.nic.in:8443/bhunaksha/.
Sambalpur district government site lists Land Records as a public service link; this is local custodian context, not a parcel response.
The landing-page-selected non-port app route returned a gateway error. No retry bypass, login, or CAPTCHA action was attempted.

Current public JavaScript/configuration inspected. Hidden state=21 (Odisha); selector data includes district 12 Sambalpur, tehsils, RI circles, villages, and sheet numbers. Viewer uses rest endpoints and a WMS renderer.
Anonymous selector request with state=21 returned administrative options. Sambalpur district code 12 and tehsil/RI/village/sheet selectors were exposed; no parcel geometry was returned.
Initial bounded request with state=21, level=0, empty codes and hasmap=true returned no body; no inference about parcel absence was made.
Anonymous WMS capabilities request returned an empty 500 response. Viewer source confirms WMS use, but this attempt did not expose a feature schema or WFS endpoint.
No WFS endpoint at the bounded guessed path. This is not evidence that the cadastral data is absent.
The viewer requires a selected village/sheet and plot number; no arbitrary plot or unsafe attribute request was issued.

schemaAndCrs.geometryTransport: OpenLayers WMS image rendering is configured; no successful feature geometry response was obtained. CRS was therefore not qualified from a response.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Viewer JavaScript refers to plotNo and internal plot ID fields in scalar responses, but no parcel response was obtained; no identity was retained or invented.

qualification.reason: Official Odisha BhuNaksha and Sambalpur-serving public viewer are evidenced, but bounded anonymous access exposed only administrative selectors and WMS rendering. No safe native parcel identity plus unchanged polygon was returned; no sample retained.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [21.4588428060781,83.9909803049859] was preserved and not shifted.
A zero exact-point feature result was not obtained and no absence inference was made.
WMS map rendering is not parcel-feature access and cannot establish citywide coverage or absence.
The viewer is state/district cadastral infrastructure; the Sambalpur district site provides local custodian context but no separate parcel API was evidenced.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native identity plus unchanged full polygon was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: The current Odisha BhuNaksha viewer route, Sambalpur district selector, and WMS-backed architecture are verified. Anonymous parcel query semantics, stable identity semantics, response CRS, exact city coverage, and update cadence remain unverified. Runtime/admission remains held.
